regional_summary_6h.headline: Iran-Israeli escalation rhetoric and Hormuz closure dominate regional threat picture
bullets: Iran's Hormuz closure-until-US-action statement and an Israeli minister's open-talk of striking Iran even with a US deal put the theater at the highest escalation risk in the window, with direct spillover pressure across the eastern border environment.

A bomb-laden device was placed at a Greek-American businessman's villa in Lefkada, with a 49-year-old suspect detained and movements captured on video, indicating an active militant operation on Greek soil rather than a routine arrest.

Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu publicly warned of Turkish expansion in Syria, while Damascus's Anti-Narcotics Administration foiled a trafficking attempt in Suwayda, underscoring both diplomatic friction and ongoing cross-border security strain along the Syrian front.
regional_summary_6h.watch: Sustained Iran-Israel rhetoric risks wider regional escalation; monitor Hormuz and eastern border posture.
